scripts.dev: pnpm run build && node scripts/telegram-preview-server.mjs --directory dist-telegram --port 4173
scripts.build: pnpm run check:runtime && rspack build --mode production --config rspack.telegram.config.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:runtime && biome lint src tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:runtime && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.telegram.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.domain.json
scripts.test: pnpm run check:runtime && rstest run --config rstest.config.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run check:runtime && rstest run --config rstest.config.mjs --coverage --coverage.provider v8 --coverage.reporters text-summary --coverage.reporters json-summary --coverage.reportsDirectory reports/coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run check:runtime && node scripts/run-telegram-entry.mjs && node scripts/run-telegram-runtime-ui.mjs
scripts.test:mutation: pnpm run check:runtime && stryker run stryker.config.mjs
scripts.test:delivery: node --test scripts/telegram-target-independence.test.mjs scripts/telegram-release-build.test.mjs scripts/telegram-release-build.boundaries.test.mjs scripts/telegram-sdk-delivery.test.mjs scripts/telegram-sdk-delivery-build.test.mjs scripts/telegram-preview-server.test.mjs scripts/stryker-recovery-scopes.test.mjs && node --test --test-name-pattern '^Telegram publishes the unmodified legal editions' scripts/legal-document-delivery.test.mjs
scripts.test:mutation:hardening: pnpm run check:runtime && stryker run stryker.preloaded-glb-resource.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.project-mutation-publication.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.catalog-wall-domain.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-codec.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-controller.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-resources.config.mjs && stryker run stryker.recovery-publication.config.mjs
